description: READ ONLY: the change history of this tenant — who changed what, when, and from which value to which. Every insert, update and delete on leads, contacts, organisations, tasks, campaigns, profiles, API keys, integrations and role permissions is recorded by a database trigger, so no route can bypass it. Filter by record (table_name + record_id) to see one record's whole history, by actor_user_id to see one person's actions, by table_name, action or since. Secrets are NEVER in here with a value: for credential columns the entry only says that they changed. The history cannot be edited or deleted, not even by an administrator.

action.description: Only entries of this change type

actor_user_id.description: Everything one person (or one key's service account) changed.

field.description: Only entries in which THIS field changed, e.g. 'status' or 'role'.

record_id.description: One record's whole history. Best combined with table_name.

since.description: ISO timestamp; only entries after it.
